title: Venezuela Signs US Military Deal After Maduro Removal #shorts
description:
Venezuela signed a military agreement with the US less than a year after Maduro's removal. In 1989, US forces invaded Panama to remove Manuel Noriega from power. History shows how quickly regional security partnerships can shift after a regime falls.
